figures.caption: Tē 85 tô.—Chit ê tô· sī teh chí-bêng sīn-chōng-lāi ê huih-kńg, kap sòe-jiō-kńg : C, phê-chit ê pō·-ūi, M, chhé-chit ê pō·-ūi; B, phê-chit, chhé-chit tiong-kan ê pō·-ūi. Tô· ê chiàⁿ-pêng,—1, sī sòe-jiō-kńg-bé, lāi-bīn ū chit lia̍p si-kiû-chōng-huih-kńg ; tùi chia só· keng-kè ê lō· sī 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8-jī sī chip-ha̍p-kńg ; 9, sī jiō jip sīn-mñg ê só·-chāi, chiū-sī tē 84 tô· M-jī teh chí-bêng ê pō·-ūi. Tô· ê tò-pêng ū chí-bêng huih-kńg kap sòe-jiō-kńg chhin-jia̍t ê kan-sia̍p : ar, sī tōng-me̍h tùi sīn-tōng-me̍h lâi ê chi ; tùi ar, ū hun chi (a) jip sòe-jiō-kńg ê bé-liu, tī hia chòe si-kiû-chōng-huih-kńg ; e, sī chēng-me̍h mñg-sòe-huih-kńg, chia̍h-ê āu-lâi jip V, chiū-sī sīn-chēng-me̍h ê chi (Blackie and Son).
